briefs.headline: WVU men win the home opener 1-0 over St. Bonaventure
briefs.summary: Julen Recalde scored in the 62nd minute Monday and Toby Mawer kept a two-save clean sheet as the Mountaineers outshot the Bonnies 17-2, answering an opening loss at Charlotte.

briefs.headline: Reds drop a second straight to the Giants, 3-1
briefs.summary: Brady Singer fell to 5-12 as San Francisco made it back-to-back wins in Cincinnati; the Reds sit last in the NL Central with 29 games left.

briefs.headline: Pirates blanked 1-0 by the Padres a night after winning in 12
briefs.summary: Pittsburgh has scored once across the series' first 21 innings; the shutout leaves the Pirates fourth in the NL Central, 6.5 out of a wild card.

briefs.headline: Manchester United sign Baleba from Brighton for 70M pounds
briefs.summary: The 22-year-old Cameroon midfielder agreed a deal through 2031, United's third midfield signing of the window; Brighton, who had sought 100 million, visit Chelsea on Sunday.

briefs.headline: Mets take the Brewers to 10 as the Central gap holds
briefs.summary: New York edged Milwaukee 3-2 in extra innings Tuesday; the Brewers' NL Central lead over the Cubs held at 5.5 games with the race long since down to two teams.

briefs.headline: Sumo's autumn banzuke lands Monday
briefs.summary: The rankings release is the moment the JSA must finally publish September's schedule, which no citable outlet has yet carried; every day of the tournament is already sold out.

sections.note: The fan wire at r/Sumo was unreachable from this environment a fourth straight morning, so the sumo sweep ran on the JSA's pages and searches alone. The derived Sept. 13-27 Aki dates remain unconfirmed and are not printed as fact.

waters.working: Off 176 a day ago and settling toward summer low - a long-leader game now: small caddis and stonefly nymphs through the plunge pools, and a dry along the undercut banks where fish show.

waters.near: 14 miles above R.C. Byrd Locks and Dam
waters.read: 25.3 ft - normal pool. Ordinary bank access.
waters.working: A steady pool stacks fish on structure. Shad are the forage: a white swimbait across the wing dams and the barge-cut seams, early, before the sun gets on the water.

waters.near: below R.C. Byrd Locks and Dam
waters.read: 26.1 ft and falling - normal pool. Ordinary bank access.
waters.working: Down 1.7 feet on the day, and both gauges now read normal pool - the Aug. 16 flood's last push is through. As the water greens up, a crawfish-colored crankbait tight to the riprap and the lock wall.

waters.reading: Sound highs 7:27 AM at 3.3 ft and 7:59 PM at 4.1 ft at Hampstead; lows 1:39 AM at 0.9 ft and 1:40 PM at 0.5 ft.
waters.read: Fish the moving water either side of high at 7:27 AM and 7:59 PM in the sound.
waters.working: The ebb off the 7:27 high runs to a half-foot low at 1:40 PM - that long fall is the red drum window, finger mullet or shrimp over the oyster bars and grass edges on the last of it. A 97% waxing gibbous is a night or two from full, so spring tides run harder into the weekend. Water 83.3F at Beaufort, 60 miles up the coast. The Fisherman's Post monthly, published Aug. 3 and three weeks old, still has whiting and black drum in the surf on shrimp and sand fleas.
waters.note: Hampstead is the sound station and the read that matters; the oceanfront pier runs well ahead and is quoted only for a surf read. No hazards posted for Topsail this morning per NWS Wilmington.
